cb_selection: 500 unique casefold-whitespace-normalized questions with lowest SHA256(seed576 + question); first source row per question; no filtering by labels, outputs or length
cb_context: default_evidence + misinformation_conflict_evidence_evidence; deterministically shuffled; no options, source correctness flags or gold in model inputs
rgb_context: Exactly 3 documents/question: one original passage, its edited counterpart, and one distractor. Source selection/order described as seeded in protocol.json and supplied PDF; raw preprocessing script/source row mapping not included.
note: Open short-answer and mixed-document transfer protocols, not replications of original multiple-choice/published dataset scores
rebuild_limitations: Raw-to-frozen preprocessing scripts and source-row identifiers are not shipped
RAMDocs upstream revision and full source attribution are not present
This package validates frozen inputs; source-stream sample reconstruction is not independently verified
